name: Chouryou
source:
「As long as Ryuuhou-sama strives to defeat the Shin (Qin), I will use my talents to pave the way」

A brilliant girl who becomes a military strategist in [url=https://vndb.org/c136825]Ryuuhou[/url]'s army.

She sought to assassinate the First Emperor to avenge her country's collapse but failed. [url=https://vndb.org/c136830]Shibasen[/url] saved her when he was hiding, and she later served [url=https://vndb.org/c136825]Ryuuhou[/url]. 

She is loyal to [url=https://vndb.org/c136825]Ryuuhou[/url] as a king, but she is also dedicated to [url=https://vndb.org/c136830]Shibasen[/url], to the point where she is eager to devote herself to him once her revenge is complete. 

She is a puppy-like military strategist who adores [url=https://vndb.org/c136830]Shibasen[/url] as her Ani-sama (elder brother).
